doctrine: Multica is the assignment source of truth. Agents trust the board and the claim model. Provider memory is a cache.

glossary.issue: Board card. Product noun. Carries assignee, status, comments, properties, parent, stage.
glossary.run: One execution. API and DB name is task (agent_task_queue).
glossary.ownership_claim: Assignee write recorded on the issue. Use --no-start when a run is already underway.
glossary.queue_claim: ClaimAgentTask: a daemon takes the next queued run under a prepare lease.

records.serialization: one dispatched/running/waiting_local_directory run per (issue, agent); chat_session_id for chat; quick-create shape for tasks with no source FK

simplifications.title: One sentence on every issue turn
Two verbs: hand off versus record
Hermes notes are not a board
One pending run, looked up rather than remembered
Do not bring the scratchpad back
Quick-create and run-only autopilot stay outside the board until an issue exists

cos_rule: Route by writing an issue: assignee, status, parent, stage, and a body a fresh assignee can execute.
Read assignment from the issue. Read in-flight runs from issue runs. Read execution rights from the queue.
Write decisions into comments and properties.
Do not store owners, statuses, or claims in Hermes memories or Codex memories.
Pass --no-start only when the write records work already underway.
After a continuity notice, re-derive from the issue.
